sentences.en: The world is a place of seemingly infinite complexity.
sentences.zh: 1. 这个世界似乎有着无穷无尽的复杂性。

sentences.en: Sami revealed cracks in the foundation of his seemingly picture-perfect family.
sentences.zh: 2. 萨米揭开了他家表面上完美无瑕的家庭关系中的裂痕。

sentences.en: Algeria is in a seemingly endless war with Morocco.
sentences.zh: 3. 阿尔及利亚与摩洛哥之间的战争似乎没有尽头。

senses.zh: 看来似乎, 表面上看
